name: Minim
description: Half notes — the head left open, the stem standing clear.

code.style: --rule: ( --flip: @pick(1, -1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 52%; width: 54%; height: 36%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 60%; top: 10%; width: 10%; height: 58%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scale(@var(--flip)); transform: scale(@var(--flip)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
